description: The Zyliss Paring knife value set is an excellent selection for slicing and peeling a range of fruits, vegetables and other delicate foods. The knife set features high quality stainless steel blades that will retain their super sharp edge for longer use. The addition of an ergonomic handle with soft touch rubber grip reduces hand fatigue while allowing for precision control. A safety blade guard has been included to secure Peace of mind while storing and traveling. focusing on functionality, durability, design, cleanliness and safety, Zyliss has relied upon a heritage of excellence that began in Switzerland over sixty years ago. Building on this time-held tradition, the brand has advanced to produce and distribute kitchen equipment that is world-renowned. Zyliss has pioneered the design of more than 200 kitchen essentials, with quality and engineering that cannot be duplicated
